description: Common, non-saleable contract loan kits. These definitions are not crate or market rewards.

items.name: Contract Arc Bolt
items.description: A contract's repeatable attack: fire a single arcane bolt for 12 damage every 0.75 seconds. Aim and release its ability key. Replaces weaker basic bolts in your active slots; no sale value.

items.name: Contract Fire Bolt
items.description: A pyromancer's repeatable attack: fire one bolt for 12 fire damage every 0.75 seconds. Replaces weaker basic bolts in your active slots. Pair it with Flame Ring for groups; no sale value.

items.name: Contract Arc Pulse
items.description: Release a close-range arcane pulse for 14 damage to every enemy within 0.85 world units. Its five-second cooldown makes it a crowd answer alongside your frequent bolt; no sale value.

items.name: Contract Flame Ring
items.description: Release a ring around yourself for 14 fire damage to enemies within 0.85 world units. Use its five-second cooldown for groups while Fire Bolt handles distant targets; no sale value.

items.name: Contract Mending Spark
items.description: Restore 12 health with a seven-second cooldown. Casting at full health spends no cooldown. This defensive skill is allowed in Spellbound and Trial by Fire; no sale value.

items.name: Contract Scout Sentry
items.description: Deploy a moving sentry for 18 seconds. It follows you and fires 12-damage light shots once per second. Its twenty-second cooldown overlaps Field Turret so a single expired summon does not end your offense; no sale value.

items.name: Contract Field Turret
items.description: Deploy a stationary turret for 22 seconds. It fires 14-damage arcane shots once per second and can be redeployed every 24 seconds. Alternate its placement with Scout Sentry and keep moving; no sale value.
